_comment: The worked example for `veridor map`. Pairs with fixtures/openapi.demo.json
and scripts/demo_server.py, and is deliberately separate from
fixtures/veridor.demo.json so the frozen finding fingerprints that fixture
The `checks` list declares the same two check ids over the same two
operations as veridor.demo.json, because the point of the example is the
gap: run `map` against this config and the matrix covers operations no
check asserts anything about. `invoice-tenant-isolation` is identical;
The `matrix` section is what discovery needs and a check does not: a concrete
object to stand in for each templated path, who is a peer of whom, which
identity is unauthenticated, and which way privilege runs. Veridor never
infers a peer group from observation -- a wrong grouping does not produce
fewer candidates, it produces confidently wrong ones.
